payload.title: West Bengal minimum wages
payload.short_summary: Effective 1 July 2026 to 31 December 2026. Zone A unskilled Rs. 10,558 a month (Rs. 406 a day); Zone B Rs. 9,760 (Rs. 375 a day). Two zones, revised on 1 January and 1 July.

payload.title: Manipur minimum wages
payload.short_summary: Effective 12 March 2025 across 24 scheduled employments statewide: unskilled Rs. 12,000, semi-skilled Rs. 13,200 and skilled Rs. 14,400 a month. Replaces the 2016 and 2021 schedules.

payload.title: Haryana adds optional monthly online LWF remittance
payload.short_summary: Notification No. HLWB/REV/2024/3755-3804 dated 9 July 2024 enables optional monthly online deposit of LWF contributions through the Haryana Labour e-Governance portal. Employee deduction remains monthly and the statutory annual remittance deadline remains 31 December.
payload.issued_by: Labour Welfare Board, Government of Haryana

payload.title: West Bengal mandates electronic LWF payment from 1 December 2020
payload.short_summary: Notification No. Labr/1700/ESTT, effective 1 December 2020, amended the West Bengal Labour Welfare Fund Act 1974 to require that both employer and employee contributions be paid electronically through the designated portal.
payload.issued_by: Labour Welfare Board, Government of West Bengal

payload.title: Andhra Pradesh LWF contributions raised to Rs 30 employee / Rs 70 employer
payload.short_summary: Act No. 07 of 2015 dated 8 April 2015 amended the AP Labour Welfare Fund Act 1987: deleted s.2(2)(i)(b), amended s.4, and added a proviso empowering Government to revise contributions by notification. Employee contribution rose from Rs 2 to Rs 30 and employer from Rs 5 to Rs 70, annually. Deduct by 31 December, remit by 31 January.
payload.reference: Andhra Pradesh Act No. 07 of 2015 dated 8 April 2015
payload.issued_by: Labour Welfare Board, Government of Andhra Pradesh

payload.title: Chhattisgarh LWF rates Rs 15 employee / Rs 45 employer (unchanged since 2012)
payload.short_summary: Under the Chhattisgarh Shram Kalyan Nidhi Adhiniyam, 1982: employee Rs. 15 and employer Rs. 45 per half-year. Deduction by 30 June and 31 December; returns by 15 July and 15 January. Covers employees in non-managerial and non-supervisory roles drawing up to Rs. 10,000 a month.
payload.issued_by: Labour Welfare Board, Government of Chhattisgarh
